typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	CPSUIArchiveFolder as string (),
	CPSUIArchiveScrubFullPath as string (),
	CPSUIArchiveTriggerFullPath as string (),
	CPSUIArchiveTriggerTemplatePath as string (),
	CPSUIDncFolder as string (),
	CPSUIDncScrubFullPath as string (),
	CPSUIDncTriggerFullPath as string (),
	CPSUIFileName as string (),
	CPSUIScrubFileName as string (),
	CPSUITriggerFileName as string (),
	CPSUIVerifiedDaysBack as integer (),
	MemberList_IID as integer (),
	PROCESSIND as string (),
	RecordCount as integer (),
	TimeStamp as string ()
}

source(output(
		DATAROW as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT \'HR|\' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112) + \'|100229|102|100|EnterpriseReporting|PDS\' AS DATAROW UNION ALL SELECT CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_MEMBERPHONE + \'|\' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER_IID) AS DATAROW FROM PDS_CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_MEMBER WHERE CPSUI_MEMBERLIST_IID= ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> PDSDNC
PDSDNC sink(input(
		Column_0 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Column_0 = DATAROW)) ~> FlatFileDestination
